courses.title: Pharmacology
courses.requisites: Admission to the ADN program (co-requisite of NUR 101 in the PN diploma)
courses.description: Introduces sources, effects, legalities and the safe use of medications as therapeutic agents: nursing responsibility, accountability, pharmacokinetics, routes of administration, contraindications and side effects. On completion students compute dosages and administer medication safely.

courses.title: Introduction to Health Concepts
courses.description: Introduces the concepts within the three domains of the individual, healthcare and nursing: medication administration, assessment, nutrition, ethics, interdisciplinary teams, informatics, evidence-based practice, individual-centered care and quality improvement.
